links.comparator_used: Cutoff threshold determined by Youden's index on the ROC curve (compared using McNemar's test), not a fixed vendor default
links.outcome: Sensitivity, false-negative, false-positive and true-positive rates at the decision threshold for AI screening mammography across three AI models
links.effect: Replacing the Youden index with the net benefit method gave a threefold reduction in false-positive rates, a twofold reduction in false-negative rates and a twofold increase in true-positive rates. Sensitivity rose to 99% (maximum) versus 72% (maximum) with Youden's index.
links.tradeoff: Specificity fell to 48% (minimum) with the net benefit method versus 75% (minimum) with Youden's index.
links.quote: Thus, the sensitivity at the cutoff threshold determined by NB increased to 99% (maximum) compared to the sensitivity determined by Youden's index threshold (72% maximum).

design_hint: decision threshold selection using net benefit vs Youden index
